PEMF (Pulsed Electromagnetic Field) Therapy

Therapy pemf electromagnetic frequency-medicine pain-relief circulation sleep

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Pulsed electromagnetic field therapy uses specific frequencies and waveforms to support cellular energy, reduce inflammation, enhance circulation, and promote healing. Commonly used for pain relief, bone healing, and sleep optimization.

Type: frequency

Benefits

  • Pain reduction
  • Improved cellular ATP production
  • Enhanced circulation and oxygenation
  • Anti-inflammatory effects
  • Bone healing support
  • Sleep quality improvement

Contraindications

  • Implanted electronic devices (pacemaker, insulin pump)
  • Metal implants (in treatment area)
  • Severe kidney disease
  • Pregnancy

Session Duration: 10-60 minutes per session

Frequency Recommendation: Daily for acute conditions; 3-4 times per week for chronic conditions

Cost Range: $150-3000 (home devices range widely in price)
